blocks.text: INQUIRER.net / Updated as of: 04:24 PM November 25, 2026

blocks.caption: Miss International 2026. Graphics by Andrei Buen / INQUIRER.net

blocks.text: Ten years after the Philippines’ last Miss International title, Binibining Pilipinas Katrina Anne Johnson is on a quest to secure the country’s position as the most successful Asian country at the 2026 staging of the pageant in Tokyo, Japan.

items: Catalina Duque of Colombia wil crown her successor at the 2026 Miss International final gala to be held at the Kanadevia Hall (formerly the Tokyo Dome City Hall).
Johnson will vie for the crown along with 73 other contestants from across the globe. The last title bagged by the Philippines was in 2016 with Kylie Verzosa.
